items.observation: One cell interrupts the upper-left horizontal wire. Its left vertical plate is longer than its right plate. There are no polarity signs or numerical values.

A circular analog meter sits above the upper wire with two separately attached lower terminals. The rim has an inner outline. Inside is an upper arched ticked scale and a needle from a lower central pivot pointing almost vertically upwards, slightly to the left. No legible numbered scale or unit is given.
items.requirement: Keep the two lower terminals separate and the upper-near-vertical, slightly-left needle. Relative to the approved FIG230 low-side upper-left pointer this is a larger deflection, not a calibrated reading. Preserve an unnumbered arched scale.

items.observation: An unlabelled horizontal rectangular semiconductor element interrupts the lower horizontal wire, with a terminal at each end.
items.requirement: Preserve the horizontal element and both connections; identify it as Photoresistor from the approved prose, not a new given.

items.observation: The cell's right plate connects along the upper wire to the meter's left lower terminal. The meter's right lower terminal connects rightwards, down the right edge, and leftwards into the semiconductor's right end. The semiconductor's left end connects leftwards, up the left edge, and into the cell's left plate. This is one series circuit with no branches or crossed wires.
items.requirement: Preserve these three external connection paths and do not connect the two meter terminals directly.

items.observation: Five distinct parallel arrows below the semiconductor point diagonally from lower left towards upper right, ending just below the element. The Cyrillic word for Light is below the left part of the arrow group.
items.requirement: Draw exactly five incident-light arrows with the same direction aimed at the element. Replace the source word with English Light. These arrows are not current paths.

items.observation: Two equal-length parallel vertical plates interrupt the top horizontal wire near its centre. The letter C is below them. There are no polarity marks, spacing dimension, area value or ions between them.
items.requirement: Preserve the top capacitor, separate equal-length plates and C. Do not add ion or answer annotations.

items.observation: A vertical rectangular resistor interrupts the right vertical wire. The letter R is to its right. Its top and bottom connect to the right wire; no numeric resistance is printed in the figure.
items.requirement: Preserve its vertical orientation, two separate terminals and R only.

items.observation: An abbreviated battery interrupts the bottom wire. Two visible short-left/long-right plate pairs are separated by a short horizontal omission mark. E is printed below. The short plates attach on their left sides and the long plates on their right sides. No voltage value or extra polarity signs appear.
items.requirement: Preserve the abbreviated supply with two visible long-right pairs and its E label, without claiming that the full supply has exactly two cells.

items.observation: The upper capacitor's left plate connects leftwards, down the left edge, and rightwards to the bottom supply's leftmost short plate. The capacitor's right plate connects rightwards then down into the resistor's top. The resistor's bottom connects downwards, leftwards, and into the supply's rightmost long plate. There are no branches, arrows, meter or additional apparatus.
items.requirement: Preserve these paths as the given experimental circuit, not an invented answer diagram. FIG232 belongs to worked example 2.
